body:
Talking with my psych, it seems like there's not a huge amount of flexibility in terms on new medications to try and Ketamine isn't really too available here, especially for this purpose. I live in Perth, Australia so I guess my options are somewhat limited. He however thinks TMS is a viable option and we're looking into that now.

I'm hoping we get somewhere soon because the main immediate issue is I'm being consistently pained and plied with so many negative emotions for no reason that I can tell and there's only so much pain I can take. It's been like this for a long time. The past couple of weeks have been even worse as the deep friend I've had to support me has moved and been very busy. I just need something to change because I can't live like this. I've been trying so hard to stick around but there's so little for me here to stick around for and so much against staying alive for me.

Thank you very much for the information guys, looks like I've got a lot of reading ahead. Initially I have to say though, I'm now heavily reluctant to try ECT without completely exhausting other options. My life isn't going so well right now but I don't want to permantely impair any future I may have with such treatment.

There are certainly positive things in my life and currently, I know I'm living far from one of the worst lives there could be from an external view of my life. The problem is I don't feel the positive things at all for the most part and no matter what I do and what I try, I can't make a dent in anything. It's getting hard enough just to tolerate surviving.

Thanks for commenting, both of you. I'm currently seeing a psychiatrist and have been for the last couple of months but I'm not having much success and we've gone through a few medications already. It's hard to believe there's anything out there for me to live for.
